channel.title: Pier & Point · P23
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for P23 (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · P23: OCII's November 14, 2024 map shows the P23/P24 area as completed park; no completion date is given. The September 2023 presentation is a plan for the Port to manage P23. In April 2019 SocketSite described the P23/P24 open space as "yet to be completed" and expected it by the end of 2019.

item.title: Correction · P23: P23's 2019 entry now says its end-of-2019 completion was only a forecast.
item.description: P23's 2019 entry now says its end-of-2019 completion was only a forecast. Source: Pier & Point editorial review.

item.title: Correction · P23: The P23 map shape cited no sources; it now lists the OCII Dec 2019 Land Use Map, the OCII Sept 2023 transition presentation and SocketSite's April 2019 article, and its caveat names the Port as manager (per OCII's deck) and notes SocketSite's name 'Mariposa Bayfront Park' for the combined P23/P24 area. The April 2019 milestone said under construction; SocketSite says only that the space had 'yet to be completed' and was expected to finish by the end of 2019, so it is now planned. The summary said the lawn is north of the Mission Creek Park Pavilion, which is about 800 m to the north-west; it now says it is between Illinois St and Terry A. Francois Blvd next to a different pavilion. 'Already managed by the Port' became 'will manage' to match the deck. The Wikimedia aerial credit names only the Commons username Firstcultural, and the OCII deck title no longer says 'CAC Item 2'.

item.title: Complete · P23: OCII's November 14, 2024 CAC update map (slide 2, "Mission Bay Parks") points its label "P23 & P24" at a light-green area, the colour its legend gives as "COMPLETED PARK". This is the state shown as of the deck's date, read from the map; the deck gives no completion date for the area (~2024)

item.title: Milestone · P23: Listed among the parcels the Port of San Francisco "will manage" (not among the 'when built' parcels) in OCII's Mission Bay Parks Open Space transition presentation, with the open space to transfer "by the end of December 2023" (an expected date). This is a plan; it does not say the area was complete or when it was built (~2023)
